messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Glimmer Issues
parts:
I logged in to http://glimmer.rstudio.com:8787 today morning and a couple of strange things happened.

First, I could see only two panes, and then only one page. I was not able to open a new script. Second, contents of my ShinyApps/app1 directory are empty.

I can still see my shiny app at http://glimmer.rstudio.com/ramnathv/app1/.

Is this the right forum to bring up this issue?

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Glimmer Issues
parts:
I got back two panes now, and am able to create scripts. But, my ShinyApps/app1 directory is still empty and I am not able to see the other two panes on the right. 

Am I missing something trivial? or is anyone else facing the same issue.

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Glimmer Issues
parts:
I think the problem is just that the divider between the left and right panes has been moved all the way to the right. (If you look at the right "border", there are two little vertical lines, which indicate that it's actually a divider which has been moved over there.) Try moving your mouse over that, then click and drag it to the middle.

-Winston
